The frozen text has TWO distinct variances - the count-weighted UNIVERSE value Var = 0.445201 (independently reproducing the frozen 0.4452) and the SELECTION's Var = 0.754664. The leverage argument is the SELECTION's 0.7547 against the all-sky 1/3, and the paper must say which is which rather than quoting 0.75 unattributed. (2) N_eq = 110,983: NOT FOUND in any receipt. The frozen text's selection line gives N_eq = 120,002.9 at 53,005 retained; the run's own plan file gives L_ret = 40,005.55 hence N_eq = 3 x L_ret = 120,016.65 for the realized selection. Also: the frozen selection line says 53,005 retained where the executed mask is 49,211 (the quality cut ran after) - the paper must reconcile these explicitly rather than blending them. Per the discipline 'if a number cannot be traced, cut it', 110,983 will not appear unless a receipt is produced for it; the traceable figures will be used with their sources named.

TITLE RULED: 'A Preregistered, Blind-Validated Design for Re-Testing the Longo Spiral-Handedness Dipole - and the Human-Calibration Limit It Reveals'. Both halves carried deliberately: the design/instrument contribution AND the terminal finding, with no overclaim - the title promises a DESIGN and a LIMIT, never a measurement.

VENUE RULED: RASTI (RAS Techniques & Instruments) - methods/instruments/techniques scope, which fits a design+instrument+limit paper exactly. Conforming the outline to RASTI's CURRENT author guide read from the publisher's own page (not memory), per the standing anchor-block rule.

AUTHORSHIP RULED: Duho Kim, sole author (Department of Astronomy and Space Science, Chungnam National University), PLUS an explicit methods/acknowledgement disclosure of the AI-agent execution and adversarial multi-seat review. The disclosure is to be written HONESTLY and SPECIFICALLY: what the agents did (drafting, adversarial refereeing, gate verification, tool building), what the human did (every ruling, the P0 ed25519 signature, the design decisions, the declined-design call), and that no AI system is an author. The process is part of the contribution - neither hidden nor inflated. Blanc concurs the filed pacing stands: number table first, parallel drafting, agy referee pass, Fable final-voice integration AFTER the Friday reset.

AI METHODS DISCLOSURE RATIFIED: Version A adopted as filed, no wording changes - including the unflattering paragraph (agent-produced defects caught by other agents), the full division-of-labour statement, and the closing 'No AI system is an author of this work. Responsibility for its content, including its errors, rests with the human author.' Placement: unnumbered Methods disclosure subsection per RASTI policy, plus a matching two-sentence cover-letter version. Blanc independently verified all four published figures against sources before the ratification: 703 findings (the appendix's own 'findings represented in total: 703'), the 177/192/334 dispositions, 84 seat-rounds (168 V*_WHOLE_REVIEW_* reports / 2 seats per round), and the 30-line P0 manifest - so all four are safe to print.

Repair round on all 11 AGY_FULL_REFEREE findings, then a fresh full adversarial pass. Non-negotiables restated by him: (1) the LEVERAGE OVERCLAIM is the priority - the abstract and section 2 must describe the ANALYSED sample with the post-cut Var = 0.7517 on the executed 49,211 mask; any appearance of the pre-cut 0.754664 must be labelled pre-cut and adjacent to the post-cut value, never presented as 'the selected geometry'; both go into VERIFIED_NUMBERS with exact sources, and every other figure gets checked for the same pre-cut/post-cut class of error. (2) The number-table rule is ABSOLUTE - 850, 51, 8.67M and 120 either land in the table with traceable sources or their sentences are cut, with no exception for section 6 because 'the spine is exactly where an untraceable number does the most damage'. (3) Kill the internal contradiction: section 6 may not say every stage passed while 5 and 7 document friction, debt and voided attempts. (4) RASTI conformance: Conclusions last, 3-6 keywords, unnumbered back matter, checked against the publisher's own page. (5) Section 1 quotes Longo's amplitude, uncertainty and significance from the primary text. (6) The bar is the contribution question - the repaired draft must read as research, a thesis argued and evidenced, not a chronicle. Re-referee with a FRESH seat if possible. If the second pass rejects on a NEW class of finding, surface it rather than looping quietly.
